answer: PoA binds every identity to bonded collateral and correlates attestations through provenance, timing, and signing behavior. If k identities coordinate equivocation, the protocol assesses an O(k^2) penalty against their escrows. A controller therefore cannot mirror independent participation: upon detecting the sybil swarm, an exponential multiplier applies to aggregate capital loss, compounded by asymmetric depreciation. No safe harbor or inlet remains
